display_name: The Six Disciples of Athanasius the Athonite

names.form: Cei șase cuvioși ucenici ai Sfântului Atanasie Athonitul
names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 5 iulie. The company is named on the calendar as a company; of the six only one name is given on the page, «Daniil».

names.form: Έξι Μαθητές του Οσίου Αθανασίου του εν Άθω
names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Ιουλίου, «Όσιος Αθανάσιος ο εν Άθω και οι συν αυτώ έξι μαθητές του», and out of the life page's own heading for them; the company is named on the calendar as a company and saint.gr names none of the six.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 5 iulie — «Cei șase cuvioși ucenici ai Sfântului Atanasie Athonitul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιος Αθανάσιος ο εν Άθω και οι συν αυτώ έξι μαθητές του»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries. The company stays one folder because saint.gr enumerates nobody: its heading for them is «Αγιοι Εξι Μαθητες Του Οσιου Αθανασιου Του Εν Αθω» and its couplet «Ἀθανασίῳ καὶ μαθητῶν ἑξάδι, / Ναοὶ λύονται σωμάτων ναοῦ λύσει», and not one of the six is named anywhere on the page — not even the Daniel the Romanian life names. The page gives no year. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
